name: negative-network-without-shell
description: Network activity without any shell exec, NOT a reverse shell. A non-shell program (curl) is exec'd and opens a connection to a callback port (4444), but no shell interpreter is ever executed in this process generation. The sequence's authoritative shell-exec step (process.exec_path in shells) never matches and the deterministic shell-exec condition matches no event, so nothing correlates (no alert). This guards against flagging ordinary network clients that connect outbound. Expect no match.
